terra.problem: The psalm does not say a man with a prominent title or résumé cannot be blessed.
The psalm does not say the man never hesitates or stands with his arms crossed, or that he smiles.
Papa says he has been in a cookie shop, adding a place he visited outside his established story.
The psalm says his heart is steadfast and he does not fear bad news; it does not describe him as calm.
The psalm says he scatters his gifts to the poor, but does not say whether he counts what he gives.
